purpose: CoPreGeneric pointer-first thumb/mouse recovery; same origin work identity across authorized projections

event_semantics.mouse: One stable URL pointer only; never paste full private transcript or issue instructions that silently change scope
event_semantics.reader: Fetch, compare exact source identity and digest, identify role/privacy scope, perform only authorized bounded work, produce independent receipt or HELD
event_semantics.identical_mirrors: Same hashed payload can be equal across mirrors; HTML projections and gateways may differ, so separately hash shared source bundle, not all rendered pages
event_semantics.fail_closed: Unreachable, wrong payload or unverified owner means HELD, not silent redirect
event_semantics.rollback: Keep last-known-good pointer and source; do not overwrite current default route without reachability, ownership and rollback tests
